Subject: Hosted API — 1M token rates & model catalog

Hi Jordan,

We're evaluating hosted inference for a prototype and need to baseline costs before we build a POC. Can you send your standard per-1M token pricing (input vs output if you separate them), and the hosted model inventory you expose (model names + short notes on latency/size tiers)?

A few clarifying points that would help:
- Are streaming tokens billed the same as non-streamed?
- Do you have a published list of supported models and corresponding suggested usage (chat, long-context, embeddings)?
- Any published volume discount buckets or committed-use pricing for the hosted API (we're initially looking at 10M input / 40M output tokens per month as an estimate)?
- We also need a note on billing (PO vs card), and whether SOC2 evidence is available.

Would appreciate a short PDF or a one-pager we can include in our procurement review. If easier, we can do a 30-min call this week.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Sara — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list. Quick summary below; attaching our standard hosted rate card for Q3 2026 (see attachment). Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through numbers.

Baseline hosted (per 1M tokens) — standard public hosted rates (list price):
- small (redwood-1-small, ~7B): input $8 / 1M, output $12 / 1M
- medium (redwood-1, ~13B): input $12 / 1M, output $18 / 1M
- large (redwood-1-large, ~34B): input $18 / 1M, output $28 / 1M
- xlarge (redwood-1-xlarge, ~70B): input $28 / 1M, output $40 / 1M
- embeddings (embed-redwood-1): $10 / 1M embedding units

Notes:
- Streaming tokens are billed at the same per-token rate as non-streamed; we prorate partial tokens the same way.
- Model inventory (hosted): redwood-1-small, redwood-1, redwood-1-large, redwood-1-xlarge, embed-redwood-1, plus a set of community-compat models we host (gpt-compat-13b, gpt-compat-70b). Latency tiers vary by model/region — small/medium are low-latency (single-digit 10s ms per token median for short sequences), large/xlarge are higher median latency but better quality for long-context.
- Volume discounts: our public rate card lists bands (10M+, 50M+, 250M+) and enterprise committed options (Dedicated/Private) with deeper discounts. For hosted, we typically offer 10–25% off list with a 12-month commit depending on total spend.
- Billing: we support PO (net 30) for enterprise deals + card for self-serve.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II report and a security evidence package is available under NDA.

Attached: Hosted_Ratecard_Q3_2026.pdf

If you can share a simple expected monthly volume profile (you included 10M input / 40M output — we can run a sample calc), I'll put together a quick estimate with a realistic discount band. Would you like some example spend scenarios?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
